quotations.old_english: Ðonne he ðæs fácnes fintan sceáwaþ
quotations.english: when he sees the consequence of treachery

source_text: of an action; cons&e-short;quentia :-- Ðonne he ðæs fácnes fintan sceáwaþ when he sees the consequence of treachery, Exon. 83b; Th. 315, 17; Mód. 32: Exon. 74b; Th. 278, 31; Jul. 606.
